# Writing — lirantal.com

Browse Liran Tal's articles about AI and agent security, MCP, Node.js security, software supply-chain security, and open source.

- [Writing directory](https://lirantal.com/writing)
- [Full post metadata as JSON](https://lirantal.com/api/posts.json)
- [Paginated post metadata](https://lirantal.com/api/posts/cursor/0.json)
- [RSS feed](https://lirantal.com/rss.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://lirantal.com/sitemap-index.xml)

Each post record includes the article HTML URL and a `markdownUrl` for its full text. Article HTML pages also advertise their Markdown alternate; append `.md` to a post URL or request `Accept: text/markdown` on supported routes.
